Technology stocks were firming in Tuesday's pre-market and trying to scratch out their first positive session in four days.
Among technology stocks likely to move on news:
+ Cognex ( CGNX ) climbed over 8% in early Tuesday trading after the machine vision products company surpassed Street views with its Q2 net income and revenue. The company earned $0.36 per share during the three months ended June 30, up from $0.31 per share last year and beating the Capital IQ consensus by $0.06 per share. Revenue rose to $211.3 million from $178.1 million last year and also exceeding the $205 million Street view.
In other sector news:
+ MagnaChip Semiconductor Corp ( MX ) jumped over 17% during Monday's late session after reporting Q2 financial results beating analyst estimates and forecast Q3 revenue exceeding the Street view expecting $197.4 million in sales by at least $2.6 million. Excluding one-time items, it earned $0.23 per share, up $0.02 over the year-ago period but topping the consensus call by $0.07 per share. Revenue grew 19.8% year over year to $199.7 million, beating the analyst mean by $14.7 million.
- Harmonic ( HLIT ) tumbled almost 10% Monday night after the video delivery provided an outlook for Q3 net income and revenue trailing analyst estimates, upstaging better-than-expected Q2 financial results.
